cues.en: build and operate Google's data centres.

cues.en: We're also responsible for the environmental health

cues.en: and safety, sustainability and carbon offsets for our data

cues.zh: 工作。
cues.en: centres.

cues.en: all over the world.

cues.en: Of all the employees at Google, a very, very small percentage

cues.zh: 数据中心园区。
cues.en: a data centre campus.

cues.en: The men and women who run these data

cues.zh: 保障它们全天候 24 小时稳定运行的团队，
cues.en: centres and keep them up 24 hours a day, seven days a week,

cues.en: they are incredibly passionate about what they're doing.

cues.en: as the herder of cats.

cues.en: MALE SPEAKER 4: I'm an engineer.

cues.en: MALE SPEAKER 3: Hardware site operations manager.

cues.en: MALE SPEAKER 2: We keep the lights on.

cues.en: MALE SPEAKER 1: And we enjoy doing it.

cues.en: JOE KAVA: And they work very hard,

cues.en: so we like to provide them with a fun environment where they can also

cues.en: play hard as well.

cues.en: FEMALE SPEAKER 2: We just went past the three-million-man-hour

cues.en: mark for zero lost-time incidents.

cues.en: Three million man-hours is a really long time,

cues.en: and with the number of people we have on site, that

cues.zh: 这绝对是一项了不起的成就。
cues.en: is an amazing accomplishment.

cues.zh: JOE KAVA：我认为 Google 数据中心
cues.en: JOE KAVA: I think that the Google data centres really

cues.zh: 所能提供的安全级别，几乎是其他任何公司
cues.en: can offer a level of security that almost no other company

cues.zh: 都无法企及的。
cues.en: can match.

cues.zh: 我们拥有一支
cues.en: We have an information security team

cues.zh: 真正首屈一指的信息安全团队。
cues.en: that is truly second to none.

cues.zh: 常言道：“他们是这方面的权威。”
cues.en: You have the expression, "they wrote the book on that."

cues.zh: 事实上，我们信息安全团队的
cues.en: Well, there are many of our information security

cues.zh: 许多成员，确实撰写了
cues.en: team members who really have written

cues.zh: 关于信息安全最佳实践的权威著作。
cues.en: the books on best practices in information security.

cues.zh: 保护用户信息的
cues.en: Protecting the security and the privacy

cues.zh: 安全与隐私，是我们最核心的设计准则。
cues.en: of our users' information is our foremost design criterion.

cues.zh: 越接近园区中心，
cues.en: We use various layers of higher-level security

cues.zh: 我们部署的高级安全防护层级就越严密。
cues.en: the closer into the centre of the campus you get.

cues.zh: 因此，哪怕只是进入这个园区，我的工牌
cues.en: So, just to enter this campus, my badge

cues.zh: 也必须在预先授权的访问名单上。
cues.en: had to be on a pre-authorised access list.

cues.zh: 然后，进入这栋楼
cues.en: Then, to come into the building, that

cues.zh: 还需要通过另一层安保。
cues.en: was another level of security.

cues.zh: 要进入通往数据中心的安全走廊，
cues.en: To get into the secure corridor that leads to the data centre,

cues.zh: 则需要更高级别的安保。
cues.en: that's a higher level of security.

cues.zh: 数据中心和网络机房
cues.en: And the data centre and the networking rooms

cues.zh: 则有最高级别的安保。
cues.en: have the highest level of security.

cues.zh: 我们使用的技术也各不相同。
cues.en: And the technologies that we use are different.

cues.zh: 比如，在安保级别最高的区域，
cues.en: Like, for instance, in our highest-level areas,

cues.zh: 我们甚至会用激光进行地板下入侵检测。
cues.en: we even use underfloor intrusion detection via laser

cues.zh: 光束。
cues.en: beams.

cues.zh: 接下来，我来演示如何进入安全通道
cues.en: So, I'm going to demonstrate going into the secure corridor

cues.zh: 现在。
cues.en: now.

cues.zh: 第一，我的门禁卡必须在授权名单上。
cues.en: One, my badge has to be on the authorised list.

cues.zh: 第二，我要用虹膜生物识别扫描仪
cues.en: And then two, I use a biometric iris scanner

cues.zh: 确认真的是我本人。
cues.en: to verify that it truly is me.

cues.zh: 好了，我们现在到了数据中心机房。
cues.en: OK, here we are on the data centre floor.

cues.zh: 我注意到的第一件事是
cues.en: The first thing that I notice is that it's

cues.zh: 这里有点热。
cues.en: a little warm in here.

cues.zh: 大约华氏 80 度。
cues.en: It's about 80 degrees Fahrenheit.

cues.zh: Google 数据中心的运行温度比大多数都高
cues.en: Google runs our data centres warmer

cues.zh: 因为这样有助于提高效率。
cues.en: than most because it helps with the efficiency.

cues.zh: 你会注意到，我们采用了顶部供电。
cues.en: You'll notice that we have overhead power distribution.

cues.zh: 电力从外面的变电场接入，经过高压线路
cues.en: Coming from the yard outside, we bring in the high-voltage power

cues.zh: 再通过母线槽分配到所有定制的母线插接点
cues.en: distributed across the bus bars to all of the customised bus

cues.zh: 这些插接点基本上就是插座，我们会把
cues.en: taps that are basically plugs, where we plug

cues.zh: 所有延长线插进去。
cues.en: in all the extension cords.

cues.zh: 我们的机架看起来都不像传统的服务器
cues.en: All of our racks don't really look like a traditional server

cues.zh: 机架。
cues.en: rack.

cues.zh: 这些机架是专为 Google 设计和制造的
cues.en: These are custom designed and built for Google

cues.zh: 这样我们就能优化服务器
cues.en: so that we can optimise the servers

cues.zh: 实现超高效率和高性能计算。
cues.en: for hyper-efficiency and high-performance computing.

cues.zh: 确实，有时候硬盘会故障，
cues.en: It's true that sometimes drives fail,

cues.zh: 我们得更换或升级它们，
cues.en: and we have to replace them to upgrade them,

cues.zh: 因为它们可能已经不够节能了。
cues.en: because maybe they're no longer efficient to run.

cues.zh: 我们有一套非常严密、端到端的全程管控流程
cues.en: We have a very thorough end-to-end chain-of-custody

cues.zh: 来管理这些硬盘，
cues.en: process for managing those drives

cues.zh: 从它们从服务器上取下的那一刻起，
cues.en: from the time that they're checked out from the server

cues.zh: 直到它们被送进超安全隔离区，
cues.en: til they're brought to an ultra-secure cage, where

cues.zh: 在那里会清除数据，并在必要时将它们粉碎。
cues.en: they're erased and crushed if necessary.

cues.zh: 所以，任何无法确认 100% 安全的硬盘，
cues.en: So any drive that can't be verified as 100%

cues.zh: 我们都会先把它压碎，然后
cues.en: clean, we crush it first and then we

cues.zh: 送进工业碎木机，
cues.en: take it to an industrial wood chipper,

cues.zh: 像这样切成小碎片。
cues.en: where it's shredded into these little pieces like this.

cues.zh: 我在 Google 工作的这段时间里——现在差不多有六年半了——
cues.en: In the time that I've been at Google – for almost six

cues.zh: 我们的冷却技术
cues.en: and a half years now – we have changed

cues.zh: 至少换过五次。
cues.en: our cooling technologies at least five times.

cues.zh: 大多数数据中心会沿着外围墙壁安装空调设备，
cues.en: Most data centres have air-conditioning units

cues.zh: 把冷空气压到地板下方。
cues.en: along the perimeter walls that force cold air under the floor.

cues.zh: 冷空气随后会上升到服务器前方，
cues.en: It then rises up in front of the servers

cues.zh: 为服务器降温。
cues.en: and cools the servers.

cues.zh: 我们的方案是把服务器机架
cues.en: With our solution, we take the server racks

cues.zh: 紧挨着空调设备摆放。
cues.en: and we butt them right up against our air-conditioning unit.

cues.zh: 我们只需让冷水流过
cues.en: We just use cool water flowing through those copper

cues.zh: 你看到的那些铜管盘管。
cues.en: coils that you see there.

cues.zh: 这样，服务器排出的热空气就会被封闭在热通道里。
cues.en: So the hot air from the servers is contained in that hot aisle.

cues.zh: 热气上升，穿过那些盘管，
cues.en: It rises up, passes across those coils,

cues.zh: 空气中的热量传递给
cues.en: where the heat from the air transfers

cues.zh: 盘管中的水，然后
cues.en: to the water in those coils, and then

cues.zh: 这些温水被引到数据中心外部，
cues.en: that warm water is then brought outside the data centre

cues.zh: 送到我们的制冷站，在那里通过
cues.en: to our cooling plant, where it is cooled down

cues.zh: 冷却塔降温，之后再流回
cues.en: through our cooling towers and returned

cues.zh: 数据中心。
cues.en: to the data centre.

cues.zh: 这个过程就这样周而复始地运行。
cues.en: And that process is just repeated over and over again.

cues.zh: 对我来说，Google 和数据中心最让我惊叹的，
cues.en: To me, the thing that amazes me about Google and the data

cues.zh: 就是创新的步伐，
cues.en: centres is the pace of innovation

cues.zh: 以及不断挑战现有做法的精神。
cues.en: and always challenging the way we're doing things.

cues.zh: 所以，当有人说某个领域的创新
cues.en: So, when people say that innovation in a certain area

cues.zh: 已经到头了，说我们已经达到了能实现的
cues.en: is over, that we've kind of reached the pinnacle of what

cues.zh: 巅峰，我只会付之一笑。
cues.en: can be achieved, I just laugh.
